description: Delete the 9 redundant per-module *_self_doc.py test files duplicated by tests/test_repo_self_doc.py and enforce that test_repo_self_doc.py remains the sole *_self_doc.py test file.
goal: Delete the 9 redundant hardcoded self-doc test files (tests/commands/test_commands_self_doc.py, tests/providers/test_providers_self_doc.py, tests/proxy/test_proxy_self_doc.py, tests/test_addon_tests_self_doc.py, tests/test_build_self_doc.py, tests/test_cli_tests_self_doc.py, tests/test_container_self_doc.py, tests/test_core_self_doc.py, and tests/test_scripts_self_doc.py) because tests/test_repo_self_doc.py dynamically checks every tracked Python, shell, build, and GitHub workflow file across the entire repository.

Add a concise test in tests/test_repo_self_doc.py asserting that tests/test_repo_self_doc.py is the only *_self_doc.py file under tests/, keeping tests/test_repo_self_doc.py well below 350 lines and NEVER modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.

Write zero docstrings and zero comments in tests/test_repo_self_doc.py (required by tests/test_repo_self_doc.py). Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Keeping 9 hardcoded per-module *_self_doc.py files duplicates tests/test_repo_self_doc.py and causes avoidable merge conflicts and maintenance churn.
acceptance_criteria: All 9 redundant *_self_doc.py files (tests/commands/test_commands_self_doc.py, tests/providers/test_providers_self_doc.py, tests/proxy/test_proxy_self_doc.py, tests/test_addon_tests_self_doc.py, tests/test_build_self_doc.py, tests/test_cli_tests_self_doc.py, tests/test_container_self_doc.py, tests/test_core_self_doc.py, tests/test_scripts_self_doc.py) are deleted.

tests/test_repo_self_doc.py remains authoritative and includes a test asserting no other *_self_doc.py file exists under tests/, passing uv run pytest and uv run task lint with zero docstrings or comments and without modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
